caption: The idf row is high (0.48) for bat, stock and market, each found in only one document, and low (0.18) for cricket and ball, which appear in two. D3 is zero under the three cricket terms, so a classifier can separate the stock/market topic from the cricket one.

spec.title: TF-IDF worked example (log₁₀); columns: cricket, bat, ball, stock, market
spec.aria: A five-row table over the terms cricket, bat, ball, stock and market shows document frequency (2, 1, 2, 1, 1), the idf of each term (0.18, 0.48, 0.18, 0.48, 0.48), and the TF-IDF weight rows for D1, D2 and D3, where D3 is zero in all three cricket columns.
